text: For hot-seat waves, apply urgent user-facing fixes first, then merge edge patches by lane semantics. When several patches are based on the same prior version, applying a version hunk can cause later queuebash hunks to be skipped as reversed; manually carry forward function-level changes instead of trusting whole-file payloads. Keep installer executable coverage, command catalog JSON discoverability, and core-surface dispatcher tests in the validation set.
